caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with a cross at the top center, colored in tan and outlined in red, embellished with blue and gold decorative accents, and radiating yellow lines behind it. Below the cross, there is a rounded bow-like shape with four elongated loops, two on each side, colored in tan with red dotted lines and outlined in blue, all meeting at a circular center. Positioned on either side of the bow are two stylized, tan-colored hands with red fingertips, forming a horizontal support beneath the bow. At the bottom, there is a large circular medallion, bordered in blue and red, with a radial, mandala-like design containing geometric patterns in blue, tan, and red. The background is a light tan with a textured, aged paper appearance.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
